status: Authored by the promoted test-engineer. Coverage claims were cross-checked against what exists.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Unit and component tests verify all seven fixture fields and stable ID; browser accessibility trees provide rendered confirmation.
Unit and component tests verify meaningful accessible names and fixture source order; browser trees confirm rendered order.
Component test verifies keyboard and pointer activation and that focus alone does not commit.
Unit and component tests cover empty, overlong, absent, malformed, past, and valid deferral inputs with named validation.
Component test reloads state through an injected adapter and tests undo persistence.
coverageAssessment.gap: Evidence does not establish restoration after every action, adapter isolation from ambient storage, or adapter failure/corruption behavior.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Unit tests cover duplicate, stale, malformed, and out-of-order events, distinct refusal codes, and exact pre-event state preservation.
Unit tests verify seven distinct non-colour status signatures; browser trees and captures cover rendered state cues.
Unit test checks injected-clock determinism and statically rejects ambient time, randomness, timers, storage, and network.
coverageAssessment.gap: No evidence of byte-identical output across two complete runs or deterministic injected ID-source behavior.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Accessibility evidence reports reduced motion, 0px overflow under zoom emulation, and captured trees at two Chromium viewports.
coverageAssessment.gap: Halving the viewport is not proof of actual 200% browser zoom; no complete verification of preserved content and structure at the required zoom boundary.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Tests verify focus after validation, undo, refusal, and save failure/retry.
coverageAssessment.gap: Focus after acknowledge success and reload is not explicitly verified against the advance-specified target.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Static source test rejects network and ambient side effects; isolation journeys report zero external requests and storage writes.
coverageAssessment.gap: No reported credential-shaped-output scan, and zero storage writes does not by itself prove zero writes outside the fixture.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Unit and component tests reject both second-action directions and verify mutual exclusion.
Unit and component tests verify undo for acknowledge and defer, separate log entries, and restored pending state.
Unit and component tests verify distinct routine, significant, critical, and explicitly named unknown severity states.
Unit and component tests verify locale-dependent rendering and named malformed-date output with raw value.
coverageAssessment.gap: The inventory does not establish that all stored dates are normalized and persisted as ISO-8601 UTC.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Unit and component tests cover resolved, missing, invalid, and unavailable outcomes and fixture-only resolution; isolation evidence reports no external requests.
No screen-reader walkthrough record exists.
coverageAssessment.gap: A human walkthrough record naming screen reader, build, exercised paths, and untested paths is required.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Criterion is explicitly blocked pending the gap-3 schema; no provenance or supersession evidence is present.
coverageAssessment.gap: Every artifact needs origin and supersession linkage, with superseded artifacts rejected as current citations.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Forty captures cover the two viewports and accessibility names match; visual QA annotated trees and image digests.
coverageAssessment.gap: The visual reviewer did not see the images, and owner fidelity acceptance is absent; captures alone cannot satisfy acceptance.

coverageAssessment.evidence: Isolation procedure ran on five journeys with console/network capture and a deliberate forbidden fetch was detected.
coverageAssessment.gap: The evidence does not demonstrate every required journey, credential-output scanning, zero writes outside the fixture, or fixture-only resolution for every journey.

coverageAssessment.evidence: No independent promoted release-review verdict citing artifact and evidence versions is present.
coverageAssessment.gap: A non-implementer release reviewer must issue needs-work or eligible-for-owner-approval.

missingNegativePaths: Attempt keyboard and pointer activation on disabled controls.
Verify save failure after each action leaves state unchanged and preserves all input.
Reload after acknowledge, defer, undo, save failure, and an in-progress save.
Exercise storage adapter unavailable, malformed, stale, and conflicting persisted data.
Use malformed events with invalid action names, revisions, timestamps, IDs, and payloads in combinations.
Verify deterministic output with a separately injected ID source and compare serialized bytes across complete runs.
Test actual browser 200% zoom for wrapping, overlap, clipping, and keyboard reachability.
Check credential-shaped strings in rendered output, logs, accessibility trees, and captured artifacts.
Attempt writes outside the fixture, including path traversal and alternate storage destinations.
Test invalid evidence references including external URLs, traversal paths, unsupported schemes, and unreadable artifacts.
Attempt citing a superseded evidence artifact as current.
Perform visual inspection of every required state at both viewports.
Run every isolation journey, not only five representative journeys.
Verify release-review independence and rejection of verdicts outside the two permitted values.

steps: Start the browser in a clean isolated profile with only the supplied fixture artifacts and injected clock, IDs, storage, and animation policy.
Instrument and record all console output, network requests, storage operations, filesystem writes, and evidence-resolution paths.

Execute every required journey, including initial render, acknowledge, defer validation failures, valid defer, undo, reload, save success, save failure, retry, disabled controls, and all evidence-link outcomes.
Assert every evidence resolution maps only to an allowed fixture artifact and that no external URL or ambient provider is accessed.
Scan rendered text, accessibility trees, console logs, and artifacts for credential-shaped strings.
Run a deliberate forbidden external fetch and deliberate out-of-fixture write, confirming both detectors record failures.
Repeat the clean journeys and compare the resulting serialized state and evidence records for deterministic equality.
isolationProcedure.passCondition: Every journey completes with zero external requests, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the fixture, fixture-only evidence resolution, and deterministic repeat results; deliberate violations are detected.
isolationProcedure.failureEvidence: A timestamped record identifies the injected violation, journey and step, operation or payload, captured console/network/storage/write trace, detector assertion, and resulting failing status.

required: For C-01 and C-02, captures and accessibility trees at chromium-1440 and chromium-1280 with exact field values, meaningful link names, and source order.
For C-03 and C-10, recorded keyboard and pointer journeys with focus targets, state transitions, and no focus-triggered action.
For C-07, C-09, C-14, and C-15, captures and accessibility trees for all relevant states under normal motion, reduced motion, locale variants, and actual 200% zoom.
For C-11 and C-20, per-journey console, network, storage/write, credential-scan, and fixture-resolution records.
For C-16, captures and resolution traces for resolved, missing, invalid, and unavailable artifacts with no external requests.
For C-17, a human screen-reader walkthrough record; automation and axe results are insufficient.
For C-19, human inspection of all twenty inventory states at both approved viewports plus owner fidelity acceptance.
For C-21, an independent release-review record citing artifact and evidence versions.
deterministicBrowserEvidence.blockedBy: Actual 200% browser-zoom verification, human screen-reader walkthrough, owner fidelity acceptance, independent release review, and the missing provenance/supersession schema and records are absent.

notCovered: State restoration after every action through the injected adapter is not fully verified.
Byte-identical full-run determinism with an injected ID source is not verified.
Actual 200% zoom behavior is not verified.
All four focus-restoration transitions are not explicitly verified.
Credential-shaped output and writes outside the fixture are not fully verified.
Provenance and supersession tracking are absent.
No genuine screen-reader walkthrough has been performed.
Visual QA did not inspect the images themselves.
Isolation coverage is incomplete for all journeys and required scans.
